scientific_integrity: No independent scientific audit, peer review, or external certification is asserted. Known renewal and no-reset winding methods are credited.
scientific_limitations: Instantaneous geodesic returns and completed-turn count; fixed positive-rate high-current limit. The closest Grange primary full text was inaccessible beyond its abstract and first-page publisher preview, so publication priority remains qualified. Analytical proof is supplemented, not replaced, by finite numerical diagnostics.
title: A factor-four rare-winding singularity for geodesically reset Brownian motion on a ring
